- [ ] `src/` changes are covered by tests.
- [ ] If `src/` changed, `npm run build` was run and `dist/` is committed.
- [ ] Documentation under `docs/` (and the Chinese root README, if relevant) is updated.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry for user-facing changes.
- [ ] No private project references, credentials or generated files are included.
- [ ] `git diff --check` reports no whitespace errors.
